test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 1: Teacher Initializes and Sets Up the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Successfully Creates a New Course with Valid Data
test_cases.pre_condition: A teacher with a pre-provisioned account ('GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com') is logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page.
test_cases.expected_result: A new course is created, and the Teacher is redirected to the course dashboard. The system displays the updated course information.
test_cases.post_condition: A new course is created and visible on the Course Details Page. The teacher is now on the Course Details Page.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Add New Course' button to open the 'New Course' modal.
Enter 'Introduction to Software Engineering' into the 'Course Name' field.
Upload 'software_eng_image.jpg' into the 'Course Image' file input.
Click the 'Send' button to create the new course.

test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher attempts to create a new course with a null course name and a valid image.
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher' is successfully logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays an error message on the new course page (e.g., "Title cannot be empty.") and the Teacher remains on the new course page (returns to step 3 of the 'Create Course' normal flow). The course is not created.
test_cases.post_condition: The Teacher remains on the new course page with an error message indicating that the course title cannot be empty. No new course is added to the system.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Add New Course' button to open the 'New Course' modal.
Ensure the 'New Course' modal is displayed.
Click the 'Send' button to attempt to create the course.

test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 1: Teacher Initializes and Sets Up the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher attempts to create a new course without providing a course image
test_cases.pre_condition: A teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher' is logged into the FullTeaching platform and is on the Dashboard Page.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays an error message on the new course page (e.g., "Course image required.") and the teacher remains on the new course page. Course creation fails.
test_cases.post_condition: The course list on the Dashboard remains unchanged. The teacher is still on the 'Add New Course' modal.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Add New Course' button on the Dashboard.
Enter 'Introduction to Software Engineering' into the 'Course Name' input field.
Leave the 'Course Image' file input field empty.
Click the 'Send' button to create the new course.
